conclusions.endurance_and_job_control: the exact Phase 8-selected Qwen3-0.6B LoRA configuration passed three 300-update slots and all eight bounded job-control exercises
conclusions.exact_host_measurements: six stable exact-host comparison cells and one three-slot endurance cell have bounded measurements at their exact source/model/configuration identities
conclusions.failures_and_untested: capture-invalid, cancelled, failed, planner-ineligible, license-excluded, unsupported quantized, distributed, semantic CUDA reload, model-quality, production-safety, notarization, and release-readiness boundaries remain explicit
conclusions.method_comparison: no confirmatory paired method ranking is available; only Full was promoted in the Phase 6 confirmatory design, and later three-slot method observations are exploratory and confounded
conclusions.model_and_configuration_boundaries: single-device BF16 LoRA and Full evidence exists only for the listed exact cells; Phase 8 records two bounded-pilot CUDA OOM endpoints and one planned-not-started point without using full training to seek failure
conclusions.workflow_completion: 47 of 149 frozen measured/exploratory/frontier/endurance slots were native-pass plus protocol-valid; all 149 retain an explicit disposition across immutable cohorts

ledger_cohorts.normalization: activated-not-launched is conservatively retained as started/unknown/capture-invalid
